_note: 2_G2 'Carnival Date' — Pinky at the carnival: meet her with flowers, win 10 tickets at the booths, buy the teddy bear, and give it to her (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_G2-carnival-date.md). NEW FRAMEWORK WIRING this wave: the mission_start_item_gate is real — root 'requires_item': 'flowers' + 'requires_consume' (StartMission soft-refuses with a hint when the player carries none, no fail/retry, matching the original's 2_G2_NOFLOWER posture; harnesses/dev bypass with the same bDevOverride as the availability gate — stores don't exist yet, so flowers enter inventory only via mission/console grants for now), and 'clock_fail_at' (mission-long edge: the date fails when the world clock reaches 01:10 — fires the 'clock:fail' event the root fail listens for; circular hours, fires at most once). v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 2-G2 cutscene is a title card + speech beat; the arrival NIS is a letterbox speech beat (the jocks' walk-off gag is skipped); the four booths run in a fixed order as our timed-hold minigames (the real carnival minigame scripts don't exist yet, so the minigame_event_bridge — shared.minigameRunning/MGaction barks and per-booth Pinky repositioning — is stubbed by Pinky's npc_follow + a bark per booth; documented); the ticket HUD counter is the stage count (collect_counter pending); tickets are an item (3+3+2+2 = 10 across the booths); the bear purchase is a reach beat at the tent (the tent-interior store mechanics are OPEN in the recon); the rides' hide-Pinky/return-at-exit teleports are skipped (no rides); the abandonment warn-then-fail trigger pair is skipped; the money<$1 fail is moot under the $10 start floor (money_ensure 10 — the original tops up 1000 CENTS; our wallet counts whole dollars); the gift/kiss is the pair_anim pair (stubs). Pass: the girlfriend_pinky collectible flag via the campaign on_pass (banner tag 2_G2_PINKYUNLCK). Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
title: Carnival Date

stages.objective: Meet Pinky at the carnival gate.

on_start.sub: Flowers in hand, nerves of steel.

lines.speaker: PINKY
lines.text: Jimmy! You brought flowers — how gallant. The carnival, then. Impress me.

on_complete.speaker: PINKY
on_complete.text: Ooh, an arm on you too.

on_complete.speaker: PINKY
on_complete.text: Ten tickets! Now the bear. The BIG one.

stages.objective: Buy the teddy bear at the prize tent.

on_complete.speaker: VENDOR
on_complete.text: Ten tickets. One giant bear. She's a keeper, kid.

on_complete.speaker: PINKY
on_complete.text: For me? Oh Jimmy... best date ever.
